# Slipstream concentrated liquidity on Aero — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Slipstream concentrated liquidity on Aero. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-11-06 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Structure and components

- [statement] CLGaugeFactory source defines DEFAULT_MIN_STAKE_BLOCKS = 5 and a DEFAULT_PENALTY_RATE equal to MAX_PIPS. Gauge divides the penalty by MAX_PIPS imported from ProtocolConstants.sol, where that constant represents 100%, so the constructor defaults are a five-block window and a full reward penalty. These are constructor defaults, not verified live Base settings or a fixed wall-clock duration. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGaugeFactory.sol · keywords: Slipstream concentrated liquidity on Aero · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/Gauge.sol, https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/libraries/ProtocolConstants.sol

## How it works

- [statement] Fee revenue follows the liquidity reward mode: the Slipstream reference says captured MEV follows ordinary trading-fee routing, reaching token operators for AERO-earning liquidity and LPs for fee-earning liquidity. Treat fee income and AERO emissions as different modes when evaluating a range strategy. (low confidence) — https://app.aero.xyz/docs/features/slipstream

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Aero documents five tick-spacing classes: CL1 (1), CL50 (50), CL100 (100), CL200 (200), and CL2000 (2000). Its quoted grid widths are approximate, and the documentation allows future classes; these labels identify spacing rather than a fixed swap-fee percentage. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://app.aero.xyz/docs/features/slipstream
- [statement] Pool identity includes the token pair and tick spacing. The factory rejects duplicate pools for that key, exposes tickSpacings(), and lets its owner enable additional spacings; a bot should discover enabled spacings rather than hard-code a permanently closed list. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/core/CLFactory.sol

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Slipstream concentrates liquidity between chosen lower and upper ticks. A position becomes inactive outside its range; waiting for price to return is an alternative to repositioning. (medium confidence) — https://app.aero.xyz/docs/features/slipstream · keywords: Slipstream concentrated liquidity on Aero · also: https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/get-started/concepts/liquidity-providers/concentrated-liquidity
- [statement] Aero describes dynamic fees as a volatility multiplier that raises the base fee in volatile markets and relaxes toward it in calm markets. The auditor guide identifies DynamicSwapFeeHook as the CL fee hook, including the priority-fee MEV tax; the implementation supports default and per-pool swap hooks. (medium confidence) — https://app.aero.xyz/docs/features/slipstream · keywords: Slipstream concentrated liquidity on Aero · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-public/main/audits/sherlock-contest-auditor-guide.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/core/CLFactory.sol
- [statement] Slipstream deposits are ERC-721 positions. Gauge deposit checks the position token pair and tick spacing, transfers the NFT into gauge custody, stakes its liquidity, and records depositBlock. This makes the holding-period stamp specific to the staked NFT. (medium confidence) — https://app.aero.xyz/docs/features/slipstream · keywords: Slipstream concentrated liquidity on Aero · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol
- [statement] Penalty configuration is mutable: effectivePenaltyConfig(gauge) combines the factory penalty rate with the gauge minimum stake blocks. A zero gauge override falls back to the factory minimum. Read this configuration before scheduling a reward claim or exit. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGaugeFactory.sol · keywords: Slipstream concentrated liquidity on Aero · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol
- [statement] The early-penalty test uses block height: while _blockNumber() < depositBlock + minStakeBlocks, a positive penalty rate subtracts reward * penaltyRate / MAX_PIPS. CLGauge applies this inside _computePositionEmissions on ordinary claims as well as withdrawals; claiming before maturity does not bypass the penalty. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/Gauge.sol · keywords: Slipstream concentrated liquidity on Aero · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGaugeFactory.sol
- [statement] The public auditor guide records two fee-hook limitations: initialFee can be consumed by a small swap before a larger swap in the same block, and a zero beforeSwap return falls back to the static tick-spacing fee. These are attributed known-issue statements in the guide, not a fresh exploit demonstration or proof of current deployed behavior. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-public/main/audits/sherlock-contest-auditor-guide.md
